entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • IDE0079 incorrectly flags necessary BL0005 warning suppressions in Blazor component tests #79854
    Backlog
  • No Compiler Warning when Nullability mismatches on a Generic struct being passed via an Interface #79845

Closed

  • Ref safety analysis for extension properties produces different results based on syntax used #79654
    Next

    Next
  • Roslyn rule succeeded when it should have failed #79824
  • Unnecessary cast added to the `default` arm in the `IDE0066` fixer #77084
  • After applying 'Collection initialization can be simplified' the cursor is moved to last use of variable instead of near code that changed #26712
    Backlog
  • IDE0072/IDE0010 does not get properly reported (e.g. no `(TEnum)0` when `Nullable<TEnum>` gets switched and `null` case is present) #57523
    Backlog
  • Discrepancy between IDE0072 and CS8510 #76080
    Backlog
  • IDE0072: False positive when using switch expression on integer #66433
    Backlog
  • IDE0072 not smart enough, and the fixer triggers CS8510 #74977
    Backlog
  • Populate switch warning suggest an unreachable default case #60784
    Backlog
  • Visual Studio is missing an option to disable adding NotImplementedException to every generated method #79681
    Backlog
  • AdditionalTextsProvider is too restrictive #79748
  • IDE0072 makes no sense for Flags enum #78634
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-10907.174 #79847
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.debugger.main-10907.206 #79846
